methodSections.heading: Vegetable Pakora
steps: Finely chop all the vegetables and place in a large bowl. Add all the spices and flours and mix everything together well. Add the water in stages and continue mixing together thoroughly so it comes together as a batter. Adjust the amount of water used if necessary. Let the batter rest for around 30 minutes.
Once rested create bite-sized balls out of the vegetable batter. Then deep fry the balls in hot vegetable oil (or other high smoke point oil) until they are brown colour.
Drain the balls on paper towel and serve hot with mint and tamarind chutney.
